`_format_progress` returns `label phase [NN%] M:SS` when both byte fields exist, `total_bytes > 0` and `phase != "finalizing"`; `NN = min(99, done_bytes * 100 // total_bytes)`. Otherwise omit the percentage and its surrounding space. Brackets are literal display characters. Elapsed seconds are `max(0, int(elapsed))`, formatted with `divmod(seconds, 60)`; minutes can exceed 59 and seconds always have two digits. Examples: `docs archiving [37%] 1:05`, `git scanning 0:02`, `git finalizing 2:00`.

`_LiveProgress` stores latest events and first-seen `time.monotonic()` timestamps by label, in first-event insertion order. Waiting/unsubmitted instances are not active. Phase changes preserve the first timestamp. `on_progress` replaces the label's latest event and refreshes; `refresh` joins active strings with `" | "` and calls `Status.update`. Use `rich.text.Text` for the rendered string passed to `Status.update` so configured labels and literal percentage brackets cannot be parsed as Rich markup. Only CLI owns Rich imports and status objects.

Create at most one `console.status("")` object per live run, lazily at the first event, and start it only while active labels exist. Stop it when the last active label finishes; restart the same object if later submitted work emits its first event. `finish(label)` removes the label and timestamp idempotently and refreshes the remaining jobs. `close()` stops the status idempotently. No status is needed for an empty run or only preflight failures.

The report loop invokes `on_result(pending)` immediately before `_report_step(pending)` inside its existing interrupt-handling boundary. from pathlib import Path

@pytest.mark.parametrize("engine", ["python-tarfile", "system-tar"])
class TestSkippedArchives:
    @pytest.mark.parametrize("dry_run", [False, True])
    @pytest.mark.parametrize("source_state", ["missing", "file"])
    def test_missing_source_skips_but_existing_non_directory_fails(
        self,
        tmp_path: Path,
        engine: str,
        dry_run: bool,
        source_state: str,
    ) -> None:
        source = tmp_path / source_state
        if source_state == "file":
            source.write_text("not a directory", encoding="utf-8")
        out = tmp_path / "out.tar.gz"
        out.write_bytes(b"old archive")
        before = out.stat()
        result = next(
            iter(
                TarArchive().run(
                    label="optional",
                    source=str(source),
                    out=str(out),
                    engine=engine,
                    dry_run=dry_run,
                )
            )
        )
        assert result.success is (source_state == "missing")
        assert result.skipped is (source_state == "missing")
        reason = "source not found" if source_state == "missing" else "source is not a directory"
        assert result.message == f"{reason}: {source}"
        assert out.read_bytes() == b"old archive"
        assert out.stat().st_mtime_ns == before.st_mtime_ns
        assert out.stat().st_ino == before.st_ino
        assert sorted(path.name for path in tmp_path.iterdir()) == sorted(
            ["out.tar.gz", "file"] if source_state == "file" else ["out.tar.gz"],
        )

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("dry_run", [False, True])
    @pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["absent", "excluded"])
    def test_no_selected_members_skips_and_preserves_existing_output(
        self,
        tmp_path: Path,
        engine: str,
        dry_run: bool,
        kind: str,
    ) -> None:
        source = tmp_path / "src"
        source.mkdir()
        (source / "unselected").write_text("must not leak", encoding="utf-8")
        if kind == "excluded":
            (source / "a").write_text("first", encoding="utf-8")
            (source / "b").write_text("second", encoding="utf-8")
        out = tmp_path / "out.tar.gz"
        out.write_bytes(b"preserve previous")
        before = out.stat()
        result = next(
            iter(
                TarArchive().run(
                    label="optional",
                    source=str(source),
                    out=str(out),
                    items=["a", "b"],
                    excludes=["a", "b"],
                    engine=engine,
                    dry_run=dry_run,
                )
            )
        )
        assert result.success is True
        assert result.skipped is True
        assert result.message
        assert out.read_bytes() == b"preserve previous"
        assert out.stat().st_mtime_ns == before.st_mtime_ns
        assert out.stat().st_ino == before.st_ino
        assert sorted(path.name for path in tmp_path.iterdir()) == ["out.tar.gz", "src"]

    def test_event_record_crosses_worker_thread_without_sharing_mutable_call_state(self) -> None:

            updated = event._replace(phase="archiving", done_bytes=37, total_bytes=101)
            other = ProgressEvent("photos", "finalizing", 0, 0)
            return updated, other

        assert tuple(original) == ("documents", "scanning", None, None)

        assert isinstance(updated, ProgressEvent)
        assert tuple(updated) == ("documents", "archiving", 37, 101)
        replacements = [
            (original._replace(label="photos"), ("photos", "scanning", None, None)),
            (original._replace(phase="finalizing"), ("documents", "finalizing", None, None)),
            (original._replace(done_bytes=37), ("documents", "scanning", 37, None)),
            (original._replace(total_bytes=101), ("documents", "scanning", None, 101)),
            (updated._replace(done_bytes=None), ("documents", "archiving", None, 101)),
            (updated._replace(total_bytes=None), ("documents", "archiving", 37, None)),
        ]
        for replacement, expected in replacements:
            assert isinstance(replacement, ProgressEvent)
            assert (
